text.p: Dynex Capital Inc said Friday that its was "surprised and disappointed" by Moody's recent rating action after it had confirmed Dynex' previous rating earlier this year.

Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday that it had downgraded its ratings on the company's preferred stock and the propspective ratings of Dynex's $200 million shelf registration, which includes preferred stock and debt.

Thomas Potts, president, said, "We believe that Moody's concern regarding the expansion of our lending operations into new product lines is unfounded. The company intends to continue maintaining its prudent underwriting disciplines to ensure the quality of loans we fund."

He added that over 99 percent of Dynex's portfolio assets are rated 'AAA' or 'AA', and that the company has improved its capital structure by reducing short-term borrowings by approximately $1.1 billion and raising approximately $70 million in equity since the beginning of 1996.
Dynex Capital is a REIT which originates mortgage loans secured by multi-family and commercial real estate properties and makes loans secured by manufactured homes.
